reportedIssues: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row, and the third card is partially off-screen without a clear way to see the full name.
The pizza card shows a green badge reading '-100%', which looks like a broken or incorrect discount label rather than a meaningful offer (e.g. 100% off or free item).
Category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) overflow horizontally and the last chip is clipped at the right edge with no clear scroll indicator.
Delivery time pills on the Fastest near you cards sit over the images with heavy white fills that can clash with varied food photography and reduce visual polish.
Bottom navigation labels and icons rely mainly on color for the selected Home state; Search/Orders/Profile are low-contrast gray and may be harder to distinguish for some users.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 1 describes the exact same defect: a green badge showing '-100%' on a pizza card, matching the discount badge showing −100% problem.
